c40_requirements.identity_comparison: ORIGINAL must have a student-cluster paired-bootstrap AUC lower bound above zero against POP_MEAN or PERMUTED.
c40_requirements.observed_future_signal: For diagnostic-test exposure >=3, C40 Topic mastery must have a student-cluster paired-bootstrap AUC lower bound above zero over RuleBeta.
c40_requirements.observed_nonconstant: The exposure >=3 observed-only Topic summary must contain no constant retained Topic and have positive aggregate median Topic standard deviation.
c40_requirements.final_holdout: JUNYI_FINAL_HOLDOUT_V1 must be frozen and unused for labels or metrics.

simple_route_requirement: Rasch/IRT-1PL or StudentGlobalBeta must have a student-cluster paired-bootstrap AUC lower bound above zero over ExerciseRate on the diagnostic test.

interpretation.go_c40: C40 retains a robust student-specific inference signal and observed Topic mastery contributes beyond RuleBeta. This authorizes only a separately reviewed one-time final validation.
interpretation.go_simple: A simple student-ability signal remains after C40 fails its diagnostic requirements. Stop graph cognitive diagnosis and permit only a separately designed simple hierarchical ability plus Topic-deviation research route.
interpretation.stop: No robust C40 or simple student-specific signal clears the registered diagnostic comparison. Formally stop the ML cognitive-diagnosis route and retain the V0.4 rule path.
